guides.conceptEn: Making steel beams and concrete slabs truly act together through shear-flow design, control of through-deck welding, first-stud bend tests and push-out tests. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.

Floors 8 to 47 of 7 World Trade Center had about 140 mm (5.5 in) of concrete on 76 mm (3 in) metal deck

7 World Trade Center was about 190 m (610 ft) tall with 47 storeys
The Twin Towers' floors had 4 in of lightweight concrete on main trusses 60 ft or 35 ft long at 6 ft 8 in spacing
Twin Towers truss-web knuckles projected about 3 in above the top chord into the slab to create composite action
EN 1994-1-1 treats shear connectors as ductile when their characteristic slip capacity is at least 6 mm

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：組合樓板剪力釘焊接
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Stud welding for composite floor systems
guides.concept: 從組合梁介面的水平剪力流與部分組合出發，說明頭釘強度與壓型鋼板肋的折減、穿板焊接的電流與環境條件、首件 30° 彎曲試驗與外觀檢查、推出試驗求取剪力釘強度，以及火災溫度效應與改修時的紀錄需求，並以 NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓組合樓板的調查、雙子塔以桁架「指節」取得組合作用的樓板，以及英國鋼結構協會對穿板焊接的說明為依據。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from horizontal shear flow and partial composite action at the beam–slab interface, explain headed-stud strength and its reduction in deck ribs, current and site conditions for through-deck welding, first-stud 30° bend tests and visual checks, push-out tests for stud resistance, and fire and thermal effects and record-keeping for alterations, drawing on NIST's investigation of the composite floors of 7 World Trade Center, the Twin Towers' floors made composite by truss knuckles, and steel-industry guidance on through-deck welding.
procedure: 鋼梁上的混凝土樓板若只是放在梁上，兩者各自彎曲，接觸面會相對滑動；焊在上翼板的剪力釘阻止滑動，讓樓板成為受壓翼緣、鋼梁成為受拉部分，斷面像一根更深的梁，強度與勁度都大幅提高。剪力釘要傳遞的是從零彎矩點到最大彎矩點之間的水平剪力總和，等於混凝土受壓合力與鋼梁受拉合力中較小者。剪力釘數量不足時，梁只能部分組合，強度與勁度介於純鋼梁與完全組合之間。
實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。部分組合時，介面有少量滑動，有效慣性矩低於完全組合的換算斷面，撓度與樓板振動因此變大。組合比（實際剪力釘總強度除以完全組合所需值）同時控制強度與勁度，太低時剪力釘會在變形能力用盡前斷裂，因此規範通常設定最低組合比。
建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。單支剪力釘的強度由兩個機制中較小者決定：周圍混凝土被壓碎或劈裂，或釘身鋼材剪斷；放在壓型鋼板肋內時，肋的寬度、高度與剪力釘在肋中的位置還會進一步折減強度，例如剪力釘位於受力方向的不利側（弱位置）時強度明顯較低。
英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。約 1 mm 厚的鍍鋅鋼承板不影響焊接品質，但鋼承板必須緊貼翼板、保持乾燥，翼板頂面不得有影響焊接的厚塗層。橫向鋪設的鋼承板每個肋內通常最多兩支剪力釘，因此肋距直接決定可配置的剪力釘數量；兩支並排時每支強度又會再折減。
拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。焊接品質取決於電流、時間、提升與壓入量的組合，而這些設定又受剪力釘直徑、是否穿板、焊接電纜長度與接地位置影響。現場常見問題是電源容量不足、電纜過長或接地不良，使實際電流低於設定。
每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂；通過後才開始量產。焊後長度也要檢查：拉弧焊接會消耗數公釐長度，焊後剪力釘必須高出鋼承板頂足夠距離，頂端又要保留足夠的混凝土保護層，兩者都影響剪力釘的錨定與耐久。
量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。焊瘤不完整或可疑的剪力釘可以鐵鎚敲擊聽聲，或敲彎約 15° 檢查根部，不合格者須在旁邊補焊新剪力釘或依程序以填角焊修補。由於混凝土澆置後無法再檢查，檢驗必須在澆置前完成並放行，這是整個組合樓板最關鍵的停留點。
剪力釘在特定壓型鋼板、混凝土與焊接條件下的強度與滑移能力，可用推出試驗直接量測：把焊有剪力釘的短鋼梁夾在兩塊混凝土板之間，從上方推壓鋼梁，記錄載重與滑移，直到剪力釘或混凝土破壞。歐洲規範 EN 1994-1-1 以特徵滑移能力至少 6 mm 作為延性剪力釘的條件，並提供由試驗結果求取設計強度的方法。新型壓型鋼板、特殊剪力釘或非標準焊接條件，都應以推出試驗確認。

剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓的調查指出，樓板梁以剪力釘與混凝土組合，長跨樓板梁在遠低於一般設計考慮的溫度下熱膨脹，推動一根關鍵大梁離開其在 79 號柱的支承座，引發樓板連續破壞與柱挫屈；NIST 建議設計時檢討組合樓板與未考慮熱效應之接頭的熱膨脹影響。
樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。不同年代的組合樓板做法也不同：NIST 描述世界貿易中心雙子塔的樓板以輕型鋼桁架支承 4 in 厚的輕質混凝土，桁架腹桿頂端彎折的「指節」伸出上弦約 3 in 埋入樓板而產生組合作用，而不是焊接剪力釘。改修時若在梁旁開大洞、切除樓板或增加重載設備，都可能減少有效的剪力連接，必須依原始紀錄重新檢核。
procedureEn: A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface; studs welded to the top flange prevent this slip so the slab becomes a compression flange and the steel a tension zone, behaving like a much deeper beam with far greater strength and stiffness. The studs must carry the total horizontal shear between the points of zero and maximum moment, equal to the smaller of the concrete compression force and the steel tension force. With too few studs, the beam is only partially composite, with strength and stiffness between those of the bare steel and full composite action.

In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action. With partial composite action the interface slips slightly and the effective moment of inertia falls below that of the fully composite transformed section, so deflection and floor vibration increase. The composite ratio, total stud strength divided by that required for full action, governs both strength and stiffness; too low a ratio lets studs fracture before their deformation capacity is used, so codes usually set a minimum ratio.

The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending. A single stud's resistance is the lesser of two mechanisms, crushing or splitting of the surrounding concrete or shearing of the steel shank; inside a deck rib, the rib's width and height and the stud's position within it reduce strength further, notably when the stud sits on the unfavourable side of the rib relative to the load, the weak position.

Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three. Galvanized decking about 1 mm thick does not affect weld quality, but the deck must sit tight on the flange and be dry, and the flange top must be free of thick coatings that impair welding. With transverse decking, usually no more than two studs go in one trough, so rib spacing directly sets how many studs can be placed, and two studs side by side are each reduced further.

In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool; an aluminium flux ball on the stud end deoxidises the weld, and a ceramic ferrule concentrates heat, shields the pool and shapes the flash before being knocked off. Quality depends on the combination of current, time, lift and plunge, which in turn depend on stud diameter, whether welding through deck, cable length and ground position. Common site problems are undersized power supplies, overlong cables and poor grounds that leave actual current below the setting.

At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°; neither weld nor heat-affected zone may fracture, and only then does production begin. After-weld length is checked too: the drawn-arc process consumes a few millimetres, and the welded stud must still project far enough above the deck while leaving enough concrete cover over its head, both affecting anchorage and durability.

Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length. Studs with incomplete or doubtful flash can be ring-tested with a hammer or bent about 15° to check the base, and rejects are replaced by a new stud alongside or repaired by fillet welding per the procedure. Because nothing can be checked once concrete is placed, inspection must be completed and released before casting, the single most critical hold point for a composite floor.

The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail. EN 1994-1-1 treats studs as ductile when their characteristic slip capacity is at least 6 mm and gives a procedure for deriving design resistance from tests. New deck profiles, special connectors or non-standard welding conditions should be confirmed by push-out testing.

Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders. NIST's investigation of 7 World Trade Center found that floor beams, made composite with the slab by shear studs, expanded on long spans at temperatures far below those normally considered in design and pushed a key girder off its seat at Column 79, starting progressive floor failures and column buckling; NIST recommended evaluating thermal expansion in buildings with composite floor systems and connections not designed for thermal effects.

Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records. Composite floors also differ by era: NIST describes the Twin Towers' floors as 4 in of lightweight concrete on light steel trusses whose bent web tops, the knuckles, projected about 3 in above the top chord into the slab to create composite action, rather than welded studs. Cutting large openings beside beams, removing slab or adding heavy equipment during alterations can reduce effective shear connection, so the original records must be used to recheck it.
evidence: 結構圖應在每根組合梁旁標示剪力釘數量與排列（單排、雙排、每肋支數），並註明是否為完全或部分組合；施工中若肋位與設計不符，須由結構工程師重新核算，而不是由現場自行減少。
設計說明應寫明每類組合梁採用的組合比及其使用性檢核結果；當樓板用途改變（例如由辦公改為實驗室或健身房）時，須以原組合比重新檢核振動與撓度。
施工圖應指定剪力釘在肋中的位置（例如一律焊在強位置），並在壓型鋼板配置圖上標示；若壓型鋼板中間有加勁肋使剪力釘無法置中，須由設計者指定偏移方向。
鋼承板配置圖應與剪力釘配置圖一起審查，確認肋位、搭接與剪力釘位置相容；鋼承板鋪設完成並經檢查後才可開始焊接剪力釘，雨後須清除肋內積水並讓板面乾燥。
剪力釘焊接人員須經訓練與資格認定，焊接程序寫明各直徑在穿板與直接焊接時的設定範圍、電源容量與最大電纜長度；接地夾須直接夾在鋼梁上並靠近焊接區。
evidenceEn: Structural drawings should note stud number and arrangement (single or double row, studs per rib) beside each composite beam and say whether it is fully or partially composite; if rib positions differ from design, the structural engineer re-checks, rather than the site reducing studs on its own.

The design basis should state the composite ratio adopted for each beam type and its serviceability results; when floor use changes, for example from office to laboratory or gym, recheck vibration and deflection with the original composite ratio.

Shop drawings should fix the stud position in the rib, for example always the strong position, and show it on the deck layout; where a stiffener in the rib prevents central placement, the designer must specify the direction of offset.

Review the deck layout together with the stud layout to confirm that rib positions, laps and stud locations are compatible; welding may start only after the deck is laid and inspected, and after rain, water must be cleared from the ribs and the surface allowed to dry.

Stud welders must be trained and qualified, and the procedure must state setting ranges for each diameter when welding through deck or direct, power-source capacity and maximum cable length; the ground clamp must be fixed directly to the steel beam close to the welding area.
pitfalls: 若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。
若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。
電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。
若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。
若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。
pitfallsEn: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost.

Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility.

A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds.

If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs.

If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高強度螺栓預拉力施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「組合梁的水平剪力流」與「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高強度螺栓預拉力施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" and "Visual, ring and replacement checks" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以剪力流計算、穿板焊接條件控制、首件彎曲試驗與推出試驗，確保鋼梁與混凝土樓板真正組合受力；高強度螺栓預拉力施工則以以夾緊力、接觸面等級、預拉方法與安裝前驗證，確保摩擦型與預拉接頭在施工及數十年使用中保持設計夾緊力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making steel beams and concrete slabs truly act together through shear-flow design, control of through-deck welding, first-stud bend tests and push-out tests; Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts centres on securing design clamping force in slip-critical and pretensioned joints through clamp force, faying-surface class, pretensioning method and pre-installation verification, during construction and decades of service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」與「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高強度螺栓預拉力施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「安裝前驗證試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Beam–slab interface shear” and “Clamp force and slip coefficient”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pre-installation verification testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以剪力流計算、穿板焊接條件控制、首件彎曲試驗與推出試驗，確保鋼梁與混凝土樓板真正組合受力；鋼構耐火被覆施工則以以臨界溫度、斷面係數與現場厚度、密度、黏結抽驗，確保鋼構件在火害中維持設計耐火時效為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making steel beams and concrete slabs truly act together through shear-flow design, control of through-deck welding, first-stud bend tests and push-out tests; Structural-steel fireproofing application centres on critical temperature, section factor and field thickness, density and bond checks that keep steel members within their rated fire resistance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」與「鋼構件臨界溫度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Beam–slab interface shear” and “Critical steel temperature”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 組合樓板剪力釘焊接
history.titleEn: Stud welding for composite floor systems
history.text: 鋼梁與混凝土樓板的組合構造在二十世紀中後期成為鋼構建築樓板的主流，焊接頭釘與壓型鋼板的穿板焊接讓剪力連接可以在現場快速完成。1960 至 1970 年代興建的世界貿易中心雙子塔，樓板以輕型桁架腹桿頂端的「指節」埋入混凝土取得組合作用；1980 年代完成的世界貿易中心七號樓，則以剪力釘把樓板梁與混凝土組合。2001 年七號樓在長時間火災後倒塌，NIST 於 2008 年的最終報告指出樓板梁熱膨脹推動大梁離座是關鍵，並建議檢討組合樓板與接頭的熱膨脹效應。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Composite construction of steel beams and concrete slabs became the dominant floor system for steel buildings in the mid to late twentieth century, with welded headed studs and through-deck welding letting shear connection be made quickly on site. The World Trade Center Twin Towers, built in the 1960s and 1970s, achieved composite floors with truss-web knuckles embedded in the concrete, while 7 World Trade Center, completed in the 1980s, made its floor beams composite with shear studs. After 7 World Trade Center collapsed following prolonged fires in 2001, NIST's final report in 2008 identified thermal expansion of floor beams pushing a girder off its seat as the key event and recommended evaluating thermal expansion in composite floors and their connections. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「組合梁的水平剪力流」到「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" through "Stud records, alterations and handover" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
